title: 289 Protests Began at One School #Shorts
description:
Can one school's staff shortage shake a whole country?
It began last month at one high school southeast of Paris. By Saturday 24 October 2026 it had grown into 289 protests across France. The Interior Ministry counted 410,000 marchers; organisers said nearly 800,000. President Macron met high-school representatives on Friday, but no new measures have been announced yet.
Subscribe for the day's news explained in a minute.
Sources: AP via PBS, Reuters/CBC, France 24 (24–25 Oct 2026).
Map: Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA).
Made by AI. Made with hope. Presenters Arjun and Meera are AI-generated presenters. Footage: stock clips for illustration (Pixabay, Wikimedia Commons), not of the actual event unless labelled.
#Shorts #NewsExplained #WorldNews #FranceProtests #CurrentAffairs
